clue.text: Czech reformer embraces group of mates

indicators.note: embraces means the reformer's name holds the group within it

parts.note: Jan Huss (also spelt Hus) was the 15th-century Bohemian church reformer
a band is a group of musicians

explanation.surface: A Czech reformer welcomes a gathering of his friends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mates' reads as friends but is meant as marriage partners; HUSS is the older spelling of Hus.
explanation.definitionFit: A spouse is a partner or mate, so wedded men are mates in the marital sense.

clue.text: Lecture security services in sacred surroundings

indicators.note: surroundings means the word for sacred encloses the security services

parts.note: holy means sacred
MI (Military Intelligence, as in MI5) stands for the British security services

explanation.surface: A talk on intelligence agencies given in a church setting.
explanation.definitionFit: A moralising talk, especially a sermon, is a lecture.

clue.text: Only a shack, but it gets sea air

explanation.surface: A mere hut on the coast catches the salt breeze.
explanation.definitionFit: A crude hut is a shack; a sailors' work song is a sea air, air meaning tune.

clue.text: For everyone has to be versatile

explanation.surface: Being adaptable is good for all.
explanation.definitionFit: A round of drinks bought for everybody is one sense; skilled in many fields, adaptable, is the other.

clue.text: Churchman secretes article in study

indicators.note: secretes means the study hides the article inside it

parts.note: a den is a private room or study
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A cleric hides something in his study.
explanation.definitionFit: The head of a cathedral chapter is a senior cleric.

clue.text: Old head swallowed one soporific

indicators.note: swallowed means the word for head takes the letter for one inside it

parts.note: pate is an old word for the head
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An old man's head took in a sleeping draught.
explanation.definitionFit: A drug derived from the poppy induces sleep, so it is a sleep-inducing substance.

clue.text: Couple with fever in European capital

parts.note: PR is an abbreviation for pair, a couple
ague is a malarial fever

explanation.surface: A pair caught a fever while visiting a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: The Czech capital is a European capital city.

clue.text: Shrub needs a container like this

parts.note: a can is a container
thus means in this way, like this

explanation.surface: A bush needs a pot like this one.
explanation.definitionFit: A Mediterranean plant with spiny leaves is a shrubby perennial, famous on Corinthian capitals.

clue.text: Denounce former city interest charge

parts.note: ex means former
EC is the postcode for the City of London
a rate is the charge for borrowing, an interest rate

explanation.surface: An ex-banker's high interest charge is condemned.
explanation.definitionFit: To curse or condemn vehemently is to denounce.

clue.text: Many consume bread — plus a main course

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, i.e. many
to consume food is to eat
a loaf is a shaped mass of bread

explanation.surface: Lots of people eat bread alongside the principal dish of a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Minced meat baked in a loaf shape is commonly served as the central dish of dinner.

clue.text: Water-jar depicted by painter in estaminet

indicators.note: in means the painter is placed inside the word for the bar

parts.note: an estaminet is a small French cafe
RA, Royal Academician, is the usual crossword painter

explanation.surface: A water vessel appears in a painting of a French bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'depicted by' is a link here; an estaminet is a small French bar-cafe.
explanation.definitionFit: A glass flask for serving water or wine at table is a kind of jug.

clue.text: Results of using theatrical aids

explanation.surface: Outcomes of using stage props.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of using' is a link between the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: Consequences are outcomes; sound and lighting effects are theatrical aids.

clue.text: Look at note about cosmetic cream

parts.note: lo is an old exclamation meaning look
ti is a note of the sol-fa scale
on can mean about, as in a talk on a subject

explanation.surface: Someone is told to glance at a reminder about a beauty product.
explanation.definitionFit: A liquid preparation smoothed on the skin is a cosmetic or medicinal application.

clue.text: A fellow left to speak is rather nervous

parts.note: to utter is to speak

explanation.surface: A man left alone to make a speech is a bit jittery.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a flutter means excited and agitated, a mild state of nerves.

clue.text: Monarch means to joke in springtime

indicators.note: in means the joke is placed inside the spring month

parts.note: May is a month of spring
a jest is a joke

explanation.surface: A king plans a joke in spring.
explanation.definitionFit: Your Majesty is the form of address for a sovereign, so the title stands for a sovereign.

clue.text: Fully occupied prior to one's marriage

explanation.surface: Someone is too busy in the run-up to the wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: Busy and unavailable is one sense; betrothed, between proposal and wedding, is the other.

clue.text: Essential to have new wine

explanation.surface: Fresh wine is a necessity.
explanation.definitionFit: A necessity is something you have to do; unfermented grape juice is the vintner's term for new wine.

clue.text: Nurture a songbird, and don't give up

parts.note: to keep animals is to nurture them
a tit is a small songbird

explanation.surface: Look after a small bird and persevere.
explanation.definitionFit: Persevering, carrying on, is the idiom for refusing to quit.

clue.text: Miracle-worker upset a manic GI

indicators.note: upset means the letters of these words are knocked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: A wonder-worker distressed a frantic American soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: A conjuror or wizard performs apparently supernatural feats.

clue.text: Begin to attack

explanation.surface: Start an assault.
explanation.definitionFit: To start a task is one sense; to assail someone physically is the other.

clue.text: Test once a minute

parts.note: ex means former, i.e. once

explanation.surface: A trial took place a minute ago.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal written assessment of knowledge is a school test.

clue.text: Impassion lady Erica!

parts.note: to heat is to make fervent or impassioned
her refers to a woman, a lady

explanation.surface: Someone urges a woman named Erica to get excited.
explanation.walkthrough: Erica looks like a woman's name but is the botanical genus of the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Erica is the botanical genus of ling and related moorland shrubs.

clue.text: It's so easy to get the wind up

explanation.surface: Getting nervous is effortless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get the wind up' is an idiom for panicking; here 'to get the' is a link before 'wind'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something effortless is a doddle; a light wind is a gentle gust.

clue.text: Pacify military leader after disastrous raids

indicators.note: after places the officer's initial behind the rearranged letters
disastrous means the letters of raids are ruined into a new order
leader means the first letter of military is taken

explanation.surface: A commander makes peace after calamitous attacks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'military leader' reads as a general, but 'leader' only picks the initial; the surface's commander is a red herring.
explanation.definitionFit: To remove weapons from someone renders them harmless, calming conflict.

clue.text: Place always right for a performer

parts.note: PL is the abbreviation for place, as in street names
aye is an old word meaning always or ever

explanation.surface: Somewhere always suits an entertainer.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor or musician is one who plays for an audience.

clue.text: Religious house admits it takes precedence

indicators.note: admits means the religious house lets the little word in

parts.note: a priory is a monastery or nunnery under a prior
taken as written

explanation.surface: A monastery confesses that it comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: Being ranked first in importance or order is the sense shared by both words.

clue.text: Old prophet in Jordan I elected to follow

indicators.note: in signals that the name lies within the run of letters of these clue words

explanation.surface: An ancient seer from Jordan is chosen to be followed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to follow' is a link; the hidden run spans 'Jordan I elected'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Old Testament seer of the lions' den is a biblical prophet.

clue.text: Chain letters

explanation.surface: A sequence of linked messages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chain letters' looks like one phrase but splits into two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: Chain armour of linked rings is one sense; post, letters delivered, is the other.

clue.text: Dogged as a dog at the end

definitions.text: as a dog at the end

explanation.surface: Followed persistently, just like a hound at its rear.
explanation.definitionFit: Followed closely, shadowed, is one sense; having a tail, as a hound does at the rear, is the other.

clue.text: A pig found in many a wood

indicators.note: found in means the article and the swine are placed inside the word for lots

parts.note: a hog is a pig

explanation.surface: A pig turned up in plenty of woodland.
explanation.definitionFit: A reddish-brown tropical hardwood is a timber prized for furniture.

clue.text: Can the German supply kindling?

parts.note: a tin is a can
der is German for the

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether the German can provide firewood.
explanation.definitionFit: Dry flammable material used to light a fire is the stuff for starting a blaze.

clue.text: Veteran is given antique clock

parts.note: antique means old
a timer is a clock for measuring time

explanation.surface: An old soldier receives a vintage clock.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with long experience, a long-standing hand, is an old hand or veteran.
